def format_time(minutes: int) -> str:
    """Format minutes since the start of the service day as HH:MM:SS.

    Hours are not wrapped at 24, so a stop at 01:10 the next morning is 25:10:00.
    """
    hours, mins = divmod(minutes, 60)
    return f"{hours:02d}:{mins:02d}:00"
